concerns.text: Task T024 mixes two contradictory actions: it assigns a "null" label and merges those rows into `labels.csv` while also stating they must be excluded from the final training set, yet it does not specify how downstream tasks (e.g., T030.1) will reliably separate these rows. Add a clear mechanism (e.g., a separate `null_labels.csv` or a flag column) and update downstream tasks to consume it.

Task T032 lacks a concrete deliverable or verification step. Specify the output artifact (e.g., `data/processed/evaluation_metrics.json`) and how the test will confirm the metrics were computed correctly.

Task T033 does not define an artifact to capture the SHAP analysis results. Add a deliverable such as `data/processed/feature_importance.json` (or a plot file) and a verification step that checks its existence and format.

Task T036.3.1 describes the audit but does not explicitly state the artifact it produces; although T036.3.2 saves a report, T036.3.1 should mention generating `data/processed/latent_audit_report.json` (or similar) to make the responsibility clear.
